label: pl/new:pgn
evidence: Portable Game Notation: a notation language for chess (and chess variants) with a formal grammar (tag-pair header + SAN move list). Standardized by Steven J. Edwards in 1994; adopted by Stockfish, Komodo, ChessBase, chess.com, lichess. Justified as a PL by the corpus's existing inclusion bar — YAML, TOML, Protocol Buffers, Avro IDL, ASN.1, DOT, POV-Ray, GraphQL, Z notation all have similar "domain-specific notation with formal grammar, no general computation" shape and are listed.
